name: Suzumoto Yukie
source:
Likes: Black tea and purchasing things for [url=/c6504]Mayu[/url]
Dislikes: Moving and reptiles
Hobbies: Lace-making

Yukie is Mayu's mother who is dissatisfied with her husband's repeated transfers due to company downsizing. The stress of having to move around have left her emotionally unstable. Her daughter, Mayu, is the apple of her eye. She has always been doting on Mayu and buys a lot of things for her when she goes shopping. Only appears in Chapter 4 of the game.

[From [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Yukie_Suzumoto]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
